description:
Your mind is powerful, reverse the cylinder.

This illusion doesn’t give your brain enough information to know which way the cylinder is actually rotating.

So your brain makes an assumption about what’s missing — and you experience that assumption as reality. As absolute truth you can see with your own eyes.

And then, just by changing that assumption, you can see the cylinder rotating in the opposite direction.

The thing is, we do this all the time in real life. We just don’t call it an illusion.

We never have all the information. So we fill in the gaps with meanings, beliefs, past experiences and assumptions — and then we respond to the world we think we’re seeing.

When we’re stuck in life, often it’s because we’re seeing the cylinder rotating in the wrong direction for the action we need to take.

We’re interpreting reality in a way that makes the action look impossible, dangerous, pointless, or simply unavailable.

But what if the direction isn’t the fact?

What if it’s your interpretation of the facts?

We experience life through the meanings and beliefs we give to what happens.

And sometimes, before you can change what you do, you have to see that the thing you were treating as reality was partly an assumption.

Now reverse the cylinder.

And if you want to reverse more than a cylinder in your life, DM me. I’ll teach you how.
